# smplkit_environment (Data Source)

Read a smplkit environment by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smplkit_environment" "production" {
  id = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The environment key.

### Read-Only

- `classification` (String) `STANDARD` or `AD_HOC`.
- `color` (String) Hex color string used in the console UI.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-modified timestamp.
